L12: # Allie K. Miller
L13: 
L14: cite2†CONTACT ALLIE L15: ### About Allie
L16: 
L17: Allie K. Miller is defining what it means to build a business in the AI age, reinventing how work gets done and expanding what companies can achieve. From enterprise to startups, she uses a renaissance approach to apply creativity and humanization to the world's most technical problems.
L18: ### Experience
L19: 
L20: Allie Miller is a top artificial intelligence leader, advisor, and investor.
L21: Allie has been named one of the cite3†100 most influential people in AI by Time Magazine†time.com and trains and advises Fortune 500 companies, financial institutions, and top AI labs. Her clients include Novartis, Samsung, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Coca-Cola, Gap, Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic. With nearly 2 million followers, she is also the most followed voice on AI business.
L22: Previously, Allie launched and built a multi-billion dollar business at Amazon as the Global Head of Machine Learning for Startups and Venture Capital at AWS, growing it into a nearly 100-person organization inside the $100B world leading cloud provider and providing scaling advice and resources to the world’s top machine learning researchers, founders, and investors.
L23: Prior to that, Allie launched the first multimodal AI team at IBM and spearheaded product development initiatives across computer vision, conversation, data, and regulation for thousands of large-scale and mid-size companies.
L24: Allie has spoken about AI around the world, advises on global AI public policy, and created over 10 guidebooks to educate businesses on how to successfully build, scale, and outperform with AI.
L25: Allie has also been named AIconic’s 2019 "AI Innovator of the Year", LinkedIn Top Voice for Technology and AI 2019–2023, Award Magazine’s Top 50 Women in Tech and Top 100 Global Thought Leaders, Chief in Tech’s Top 100 Women in Tech to Watch in 2022, ReadWrite’s Top 20 AI Speakers in the World, MKAI’s Top 20 AI Mavericks, Data Salon’s Top 25 Data Science influencers in the world, Neptune’s Top 20 AI Influencers, Ad Week Top 100 Trailblazers, and The Wharton School’s 10 under 10.
L26: Allie is also a national ambassador for the American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS) and an angel investor in top AI startups.
L27: Allie's groundbreaking insights on AI have been featured in Forbes, Fortune, Wall Street Journal, Washington Post, Ad Age, and more.
L28: Allie holds a double-major MBA from The Wharton School and a BA in Cognitive Science (coding a three-year ML study and studying Computer Science, Linguistics, Psychology) from Dartmouth College.
